abstract: Analysis of Indeed job posting data reveals that US job postings have declined 15% from peak levels, with traditional administrative and customer service roles experiencing the steepest declines of 18-27%. Conversely, AI/ML positions have grown 42% year-over-year, indicating a significant shift in labor demand toward artificial intelligence-related skills and away from routine cognitive tasks.
keyFindings: US job postings are 15% below their peak level as of January 2025
Data entry job postings declined 27%, the steepest category decline
Customer service postings fell 18% and basic administrative postings declined 22%
AI/ML job postings increased 42% year-over-year, showing strong growth in AI-related positions
methodology: Analysis of Indeed job posting data tracking trends in US labor demand across job categories, comparing year-over-year changes and identifying posting volume changes from peak levels.
